771041801.text: Huh, this lamp is weird. But for some reason... now that we're near it, the blizzard's easing up. It even feels kind of warm...

771041802.text: Wait a minute. Paimon's heard that if you suddenly start feeling warm on a snowy mountain, it could mean you're so cold you're starting to hallucinate...

771041804.text: Aha! So you felt it too! It really is getting warmer!

771041807.text: Don't worry, you two. This is a special lamp. They say it was blessed by the fae that is now inside it a long time ago.

771041808.text: It offers some protection from the cold.

771041809.text: Whoa! D—did someone just... appear out of nowhere?

771041811.text: This is my lamp. I left it here earlier when I got a little bored and went for a walk.

771041812.text: Oh, so it's yours... Wait, you went for a walk in this blizzard? Dressed like that? How are you not freezing?

771041814.text: Should I be reacting to temperature changes? Is that what you were expecting?

771041815.text: Uh... That's not really the point. Most people would freeze solid if they wore that little in this weather like this.

771041806.text: Uh... We're surrounded by snow and ice, and we still need to convince ourselves we're cold...?

subQuests.subQuestName: Follow Ikor to the House of Hesperides

771040101.text: Myshkin? Is that you? You're finally here...

771040102.text: #...Huh? Who's Myshkin? No, we're just passing adventurers — {NICKNAME} and Paimon!

771040103.text: We heard there was a wedding happening here, so we came by to take a look! And we do have an invite, so it's not like we're crashing the wedding, right?

771040105.text: Please present your invitation to the statue by the door.

771040107.text: (Ikor, you came from in there, right? Then you must know this place better than we do. Do they always have weird rules like this?)

771040108.text: (This does not seem to be part of the "ritual.")

771040109.text: (So you're just as lost as we are. Well, since we're already here, let's just do what she said for now.)

771040201.text: The wedding is about to begin. We ask our guests to wait in the hall in the meantime...

771042201.text: Paimon's starting to feel a little nervous. It's like the Chicken-Mushroom Skewer she had this morning is dancing around in her stomach... Ugh.

771042202.text: Paimon wonders what Pavlina, the princess of the Snegurochka, is like... and what kind of person the groom is, too...

771042203.text: If Aglaya's story is anything to go by, Pavlina sounds completely enchanted with him. Humans even tried to steal him away! He must be some kind of once-in-a-lifetime heartthrob.

771042204.text: ...Maybe this wedding is more than it seems.

771042205.text: #If what {NICKNAME} saw in the Pale Crown Palace really happened, then Pavlina was one of the people who betrayed Miss Aksinya... Which means...

771042206.text: Pavlina probably has one of the pieces of your body.

771042207.text: Right. The one who has the fragmented power of my body is... Ikor. So I suspect the groom may be...

771042209.text: Whoa! Where did she come from?

771042210.text: She's the mistress of this place. A trick like that is child's play for her.

771042213.text: Just as I expected. She carries a piece of my body's power in her life too.

771042215.text: Today is a special day. We were a people that no one ever blessed or cared for. But that changes now.

771042216.text: Love is what truly feeds the soul.

771042217.text: We were born without souls, so we chased after love because we longed to have one. We live for love, and we live because of love.

771042218.text: Yes. Human love is what gives us souls. It is what allows us to become beings in our own right.

771042219.text: But the humans who share their souls with us, they can be such terrible creditors who end up forcing us to live by the rules of their fickle love...

771042220.text: Larisa once stood here, too. You all saw the betrayal she suffered with your own eyes — vile enough to cost her both her soul and her life.

771042221.text: But her death brought no shame upon us. On the contrary, it was something to be proud of, for it proved that nobility was always part of her nature.

771042222.text: Nevertheless, her passing was a great loss to us, for there was no Snegurochka more pure-minded than Larisa.

771042223.text: Pavlina, though... During her time at the Alypium — no, perhaps even before then... she had already been tainted by human ways.

771042224.text: That would probably explain why she sees things this way. It is the sort of idea only a human could have, even if Pavlina herself does not realize it.

771042225.text: Looks like not everyone agrees with her.

771042226.text: Actually, what Paimon really wants to know is, is that going to be your speech at the wedding? It sure doesn't sound like one...

771042227.text: ...Her wrongful death will be the final page in our kind's tragic chapter.

771042228.text: The new beginning granted to us by the gods shall soon arrive, and from this day forward, our soulless past shall finally come to an end.

771042229.text: You never knew the truth, and there is no need for you to know it now... For this day to come, a sacrifice had already been made some time ago.

771042230.text: Huh? What's happening??? It feels like the air in the room has just changed all of a sudden...

771042231.text: Come to us, soul-water, born of the gods and made for the gods.

771042232.text: Come to us, Ikor. Come. Offer yourself up for our sake.

771042235.text: He can't seem to hear Paimon... What's wrong with him? Did someone do this to him? Or is it that shackle?

771042236.text: #We have to do something, {NICKNAME}! Paimon has a feeling this "ritual" isn't the wedding we thought it was going to be...

771042237.text: No, it isn't. It is a ritual to transfer the power held in my body...

771042238.text: However the Snegurochka princess came to possess that fragment of power before, she must have found a way to claim the rest of it now...

771042239.text: She wants to defy the natural order and give those under her protection souls. But she would never be able to do that by herself alone. And that is where that power comes in.

771042240.text: Then we must do something now! She's going to take him!

771042241.text: Say it, Ikor. Do you promise to give us what we've been wishing for?

771042244.text: ...I know this is probably the last thing anyone wants to hear right now, but a Court Jester is supposed to speak up when advice is needed, isn't she?

771042245.text: ...Aksinya. Though I do not know how you managed to escape that inescapable prison... But you were not invited to today's proceedings.

771042246.text: ...You never would have said that to me in the past, Pavlina.

771042247.text: What changed you? Was it the pain of an ambition that could never be satisfied?

771042248.text: But you and I both know I have every right to be here — as an uninvited guest.

771042250.text: Why keep on fighting when you know it won't change anything? You know you won't win, not even now.

771042251.text: I know. And that's why I came with some help this time.

771042252.text: A cheap little trick. All that will do is buy you a little time...

771042253.text: You simply do not understand, Aksinya. The sacrifice has already been made. That means the ending has already been set in motion, and there is nothing you can do to stop it.\nSo I failed this time. But what difference does it make? It's just one more "rehearsal"...\nNext time... Next time, it will work...

subQuests.subQuestName: Hand over the invite by the statue

771040301.text: The wedding is about to begin. We ask our guests to wait in the hall in the meantime...

771041201.text: Huh? Where did Ikor go? Goggles, did you see where he went?

771041202.text: My apologies. Some special ritual power seems to be affecting this entire place. I can no longer sense his presence. Given some time, I may be able to determine what's going on...

771041203.text: Honestly, Paimon still had so many questions for him. Like, if he's obviously just one part of one part of Goggles' body, how does he have a whole body of his own...?

771041204.text: That part is easy enough to understand. It is like... "A pomegranate split open, its seeds scattered across the ground. Piece the shell back together, and it can still, just barely, be called whole."

771041205.text: Ugh... Okay, even if he isn't really human, that example was still pretty creepy.

771041206.text: But we're out of leads for now, so we'll just have to wait for Goggles to figure things out.

771041207.text: #Come on, {NICKNAME}, let's go soak up the wedding atmosphere! It's not every day you get to see a Snegovik wedding!

771040701.text: Oh! Looks like it's time! Everyone's heading toward the assembly hall.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the main hall for the wedding

771041301.text: Huh? Where did Ikor go? Goggles, did you see where he went?

771041302.text: My apologies. Some special ritual power seems to be affecting this entire place. I can no longer sense his presence. Given some time, I may be able to determine what's going on...

771041308.text: ...As far as I know, Pavlina, princess of the Snegurochka, isn't really the type to marry a human. How strange.

771041309.text: If anything... I would have thought she'd be more attached to her own kind than to humans...

771041310.text: Well, you never know! Maybe she met the one and went, "Hehe, I don't care what anyone says! I'm marrying him!"

771041311.text: It's possible, but the chances are slim.

771041312.text: Still... perhaps the wedding itself is the clue.

771041313.text: Okay, then let's go to the wedding and see what we can find out! It's a Snegovik wedding, after all!

771041902.text: Whew — there you are! Did the bell wake you? You were completely out. Is the bed here really that comfy?

771041903.text: I think I had a dream.

771041904.text: No wonder. You were asleep for a long time. Paimon's been keeping watch the whole while. Was it a nice dream, or a scary one?

771041905.text: Actually, never mind. Tell Paimon later. Now's not really the time.

771041906.text: Do you remember what happened earlier? We came to the House of Hesperides for a wedding.

771041907.text: But that "ritual" wasn't a wedding at all.

771041908.text: That towering princess of the Snegurochka, Pavlina... She nearly killed Ikor...

771041909.text: Paimon knows Ikor isn't really human, strictly speaking. He's just a fragment of the power that originally belonged to Goggles. But even so...

771041910.text: Compassion is something to be respected, Miss Paimon.

771041911.text: Thanks, Goggles. Oh, right, when Pavlina cast her spell, Goggles was the one who protected us and brought us here, somewhere safe.

771041912.text: While you were asleep, Paimon did some poking around. Looks like someone named Myshkin used to live here. Didn't Aglaya mention him when she first welcomed us?

771041913.text: ...*cough* Hello? Do you copy? You should be able to hear what I'm saying?

771041914.text: *sigh* Thanks for nothing, you two. I poured so much effort into getting "him" out, even if in part... Only for you to send him right back, as if nothing had happened. Pavlina almost won right there and then.

771041915.text: Huh? Aksinya! Wait, how are you coming through Goggl—?

771041916.text: Ha! I am the creator of the Eye of Graeae, after all. I can still make use of some of its functions.

771041917.text: ...Hmm. It's been a while since we last met, eh, dear colleague? Don't you think you're getting "a bit too passionate" right now?

771041918.text: Ah, sorry, that wasn't meant for you. I'm currently busy dealing with that crazy shrew... How tragic, Pavlina of the Snegovik. You've completely lost it.

771041919.text: Her gaze is like Prime Ice, but her mind is like a powderkeg. A single spark could set her off and destroy all around her.

771041920.text: I've trapped Pavlina, but have little time for anything else right now. Take "his" fragments away from here, one by one, while she's weakened by being in this area, away from her grasp.

771041921.text: That's the only way to ensure that shrew won't be able to offer up "his" power for her people.

771041922.text: We have to take back all that power, don't we? It's not the same as why she seeks your power, is it? "To have a body once more"... that's what you wish for, isn't it?

771041924.text: Then go. I won't be able to hold out for long... Hurry—

771041926.text: Take Goggles' fragments... one by one? What does she even mean? Doesn't she know that Pavlina has some of Goggles' power too???

771041927.text: She may have something else up her sleeves too.

771041928.text: Yeah... Better take what she says with a huge rock of salt. But what should we do now then?

771041929.text: Hey, you know what? This is about Goggles! We should ask what he wants.

771041930.text: I think... Maybe we should gather at least some of the power that has been split up, and try to make him as complete as possible. Then we can take it all back.

771041931.text: This may sound a little ironic, but my wish is for the fragments, incomplete as they are, to be as whole as possible...

771041932.text: It's just like how the Snegurochka princess must have decided to perform the ritual because she wanted to help her people become more "whole."

771041933.text: And that is something I can understand, and even empathize with, to some degree.

771041934.text: How can you feel for her!? She was gonna gobble you up, piece by piece, just to get what she wanted!!!

771041935.text: Paimon can share her food or Mora with other folks, no problem. But if you want Paimon to hand over an arm or a leg...

771041936.text: Or even Paimon's hair! Hmm... Actually, hair seems alright... especially if it's just a few strands—— Anyway, that's not the point.

771041937.text: It doesn't matter what the other person's reasons are. This is something... something Paimon needs to think over! Very carefully! Though Paimon probably won't say yes anyway, to be honest...

771041938.text: Yes. It's not good to over-deplete yourself for the sake of others.

771041939.text: ...You are right. But that aside, there is another reason we must reclaim him "whole."

771041940.text: Another reason? And what would that be?

771041942.text: That you don't need to know, Paimon.

771041943.text: Huh? Are the two of you keeping something from Paimon!? And Paimon's not talking about secret snack stashes or anything like tha——

771041945.text: I have marked the fragment locations. Let's go, before the clock strikes ten.

771040501.text: The "ritual" is already underway. Please go on in... There's no need to be anywhere else...

subQuests.subQuestName: Get some rest before the wedding begins

771042301.text: The "ritual" is already underway. Please go on in... There's no need to be anywhere else...

771041401.text: #{NICKNAME}, you're already worn out? But what about the fun activities afterward...

771041406.text: Exhaustion seems to have finally caught up with you. You and Paimon curl up together on the sofa, drifting into a light doze. Then, somewhere between sleep and waking, ten faint chimes ring out...

subQuests.subQuestName: Take a seat at the chapel

771040906.text: Paimon was thinking the same thing. But today's supposed to be a happy occasion, and everyone's here to offer her their blessings.

771040907.text: If we catch her in a good mood, maybe she'll let a clue or two slip.

771040908.text: I have my doubts, Miss Paimon. Still, I agree. This is a good chance to gather clues up close.

771040953.text:
"The clock strikes again."
A cold voice whispers the words in your ear. You know this isn't the first time you've heard something like this before.
In that voice, you hear a soul taking shape, polished by countless trials until it slowly grows to be more beautiful. That is, if pain, too, could be called beautiful...
In that same voice, you hear a soul taking form, growing ever more magnificent as it undergoes an endless process of transcendence. That is, if distortion, too, could be called magnificent...

771040954.text:
Each time brings greater pain than the last.
Each time brings you closer to the thing you've been longing for...
And yet...
The mouth opens, then slowly closes again. It is too late. No words can stop what has already begun.
After all, that wish matters more than anything now.

771040955.text:
"Yes. The clock strikes again. So let us begin once more. Your..."
You say you know you've heard these words before...
"Mine."\nn"'Ours...'"
"This endless 'wedding' of ours."

771041501.text: Should we wait here until the wedding starts?

771041503.text: Exhaustion seems to have finally caught up with you. You and Paimon curl up together on the sofa, drifting into a light doze. Then, somewhere between sleep and waking, eight faint chimes ring out...

771041505.text: Huh? Then we'd better hurry! We don't want to be late to a wedding.

771040401.text: Welcome to the House of Hesperides.

771040402.text: Since you have an invitation, then you are guests of this house, and every guest deserves a proper welcome. You may call me Aglaya.

771040403.text: Is this your first time attending a Snegovik wedding?

771040405.text: You two do not seem to be from around here, so I take it you have not heard about the scandal. I doubt you would have been willing to come here if you had.

771040407.text: At least, humans would call it that. The last ceremonial ritual we held on this scale was Larisa's wedding.

771040408.text: But that human betrayed her in the end. She killed him, and then the vow took her life, too.

771040409.text: Larisa was the most beautiful of us all... even the way she died was beautiful.

771040410.text: That day, her fury brought down a blizzard so fierce, it froze even the bolts of lightning mid-fall. You should have seen that beautiful, deadly Prime Ice magic...

771040412.text: Heh, but you have no cause for worry. You will be safe here at the House of Hesperides, as long as you stay away from what is forbidden.

771040413.text: The ritual will begin when <color=#00E1FFFF>the clock strikes eight times</color>. Please make your way to the chapel right away when you hear it.

771040414.text: Until then, you may look around the main hall... The other rooms are not open to guests...

771040415.text: But you are welcome to enjoy the entertainment here, or simply rest for a while. The choice is yours.

771040416.text: So, about those rooms we're not allowed into...

771040417.text: Some of those are private quarters. We even have one set aside for the bride and groom...

771040418.text: Ah, excuse. I didn't mean to be rude.

771040419.text: Once, there was a human woman who dared sneak into the groom's room while he was alone. Of course, she was caught almost immediately...

771040420.text: Wh-what!? Was she trying to steal the groom or something???

771040421.text: Not from Pavlina, the Snegurochka princess. What Pavlina has laid claim to, no one takes from her.

771040422.text: So cold is she by nature, she hardly seems like a Snegurochka at all. But that boy was hers, and there was no way she would let anyone take him away.

771040423.text: ...Regardless of that, the ritual will go ahead, and we will succeed this time. She has sworn it on the sword Larisa once wielded.

771040424.text: And we all know what happens to those who break their vows.

771040425.text: Enough of the dull introductions. This ritual is one that is worth celebrating after all. I wish the both of you a most pleasant and unforgettable day here at the House of Hesperides.

771040426.text: Oh my, you ended up all the way over here?

771040427.text: Let's get you back where you're supposed to be.

771041724.text: That would probably explain why she sees things this way. It is the sort of idea only a human could have, even if Pavlina herself does not realize it.

771041725.text: Looks like not everyone agrees with her.

771041726.text: Actually, what Paimon really wants to know is, is that going to be your speech at the wedding? It sure doesn't sound like one...

771041727.text: ...Her wrongful death will be the final page in our kind's tragic chapter.

771041728.text: The new beginning granted to us by the gods shall soon arrive, and from this day forward, our soulless past shall finally come to an end.

771041729.text: You never knew the truth, and there is no need for you to know it now... For this day to come, a sacrifice had already been made some time ago.

771041730.text: Huh? What's happening??? It feels like the air in the room has just changed all of a sudden...

771041731.text: Come to us, soul-water, born of the gods and made for the gods.

771041732.text: Come to us, Ikor. Come. Offer yourself up for our sake.

771041735.text: He can't seem to hear Paimon... What's wrong with him? Did someone do this to him? Or is it that shackle?

771041736.text: #We have to do something, {NICKNAME}! Paimon has a feeling this "ritual" isn't the wedding we thought it was going to be...

771041737.text: No, it isn't. It is a ritual to transfer the power held in my body...

771041738.text: However the Snegurochka princess came to possess that fragment of power before, she must have found a way to claim the rest of it now...

771041739.text: She wants to defy the natural order and give those under her protection souls. But she would never be able to do that by herself alone. And that is where that power comes in.

771041740.text: Then we must do something now! She's going to take him!

771041741.text: Say it, Ikor. Do you promise to give us what we've been wishing for?

771041743.text: I object to this ritual! ...I know this is probably the last thing anyone wants to hear right now, but a Court Jester is supposed to speak up when advice is needed, isn't she?

771041744.text: ...Aksinya. Though I do not know how you managed to escape that inescapable prison... But you were not invited to today's proceedings.

771041745.text: Yes, yes, you already told me that earlier today. With not a trace of kindness left for an old colleague. How sad.

771041746.text: But you and I both know I have every right to be here — as an uninvited guest.

771041748.text: Why keep on fighting when you know it won't change anything? You know you won't win, not even now.

771041749.text: I know. And that's why I came with some help this time.

771041750.text: A cheap little trick. All that will do is buy you a little time...

771041751.text: You simply do not understand, Aksinya. The sacrifice has already been made. That means the ending has already been set in motion, and there is nothing you can do to stop it.\nSo I failed this time. But what difference does it make? It's just one more "rehearsal"...\nNext time... Next time, it will work...

771042001.text: Huh, this lamp is weird. But for some reason... now that we're near it, the blizzard's easing up. It even feels kind of warm...

771042002.text: Wait a minute. Paimon's heard that if you suddenly start feeling warm on a snowy mountain, it could mean you're so cold you're starting to hallucinate...

771042004.text: Aha! So you felt it too! It really is getting warmer!

771042007.text: Don't worry, you two. This is a special lamp. They say it was blessed by the fae that is now inside it a long time ago.

771042008.text: It offers some protection from the cold.

771042009.text: Whoa! D—did someone just... appear out of nowhere?

771042010.text: Hello, you two. Don't be so alarmed, my flying friend.

771042011.text: This is my lamp. I left it here earlier when I got a little bored and went for a walk.

771042012.text: Oh, so it's yours... Wait, you went for a walk in this blizzard? Dressed like that? How are you not freezing?

771042014.text: Should I be reacting to temperature changes? Is that what you were expecting?

771042015.text: Uh... That's not really the point. Most people would freeze solid if they wore that little in this weather like this.

771042006.text: Uh... We're surrounded by snow and ice, and we still need to convince ourselves we're cold...?

771042101.text: Hmm. It feels like the farther up the mountain we go, the heavier the storm gets...

771042104.text: An invitation? Let Paimon take a look... Hmm. It says Pavlina, Grand Duchess of the Snegurochka, is inviting... whoever's holding this invitation to attend a wedding...?

771042105.text: "Those who wish to attend the ceremony may present this invitation as proof that they have been invited..."

771042106.text: Hmm... So the wedding is being held at... House of Hesp-something, up on the snowy mountain...

771042107.text: House of Hesperides. Yes. It was once home to the sovereign who ruled over the Snegovik. As for Pavlina...

771042108.text: That name does sound faintly familiar...

771042109.text: So, Pavlina, the princess of the Snegurochka, might be tied to Goggles' past too?

771042111.text: The house's all the way up the mountain? And we still have to climb higher?

771042112.text: I'm afraid so. Unless House of Hesperides somehow moved in the last five hundred years...

771042113.text: Fine. Then let's keep going and check it out.

771049901.text: The house is just past the bridge.

771049907.text: Wow, it's really lively here... Is this part of the activities that Snegurochka mentioned?

771049912.text: Stay close, I'll light the lamp for you. There's nothing to fear.

771049916.text: Come on, let's go take a look!

771049941.text: #The bell's ringing again. But why? Paimon has a really bad feeling about this... {NICKNAME}, we need to hurry...

771049947.text: Looks like all the wedding guests are Snegovik...

771049948.text: Wait, are we even supposed to be here? And Ikor's nowhere to be seen either...

771049949.text: Goggles, you said he was part of your power, didn't you? So when you get your body back, will you look like him too?

771049950.text: I cannot say for certain, but it is possible.

771049951.text: #Hmm... Don't worry, {NICKNAME}! Even if Goggles ends up being super good-looking, Paimon's still your number one guide!

771049953.text: Looks like all the wedding guests are Snegovik...

771049954.text: Wait, are we even supposed to be here? And Ikor's nowhere to be seen either...

771049955.text: Goggles, you said he was part of your power, didn't you? So when you get your body back, will you look like him too?

771049956.text: Now that Paimon thinks about it, Anka from that mumbly-jumbly town kind of looked like him too.

771049957.text: I cannot say for certain, but it is possible.

771049958.text: #Hmm... Don't worry, {NICKNAME}! Even if Goggles ends up being super good-looking, Paimon's still your number one guide!

771049960.text: Hmm, Pavlina, princess of the Snegurochka... Paimon feels like that name's come up before...

771049961.text: #The Pale Crown Palace... {NICKNAME} told us about the past {M#he}{F#she} saw in the Shadow Realm.

771049962.text: Pavlina... Yes. She was one of the great ones who presided over the Alypium — princess of the Snegovik clan.

771049963.text: Oh, so that's who she was... And that Ikor felt kind of off, too...
